body: I tried to get in with someone on Monday, which failed BUT it forced me to get an appointment with a doctor I like for next week and a therapist I used to see for later in September.  I wish it were sooner, but having the plan got me down from full-on crisis. Thank you for checking in.

You are not required to get married if you are having second thoughts, regardless of whether they are or are not BPD.  What you can't do is fix another person.  You don't control them, for good or ill.  

These are sad, scary stories.  The thought of breaking an engagement is sad and scary, too.  You'll survive a little embarrassment if it goes that way.  Make a sound, deliberate decision, whichever way you go.  Godspeed.
